lines.text: Aim for the center when the ring is small...\nI hear that’s the trick when throwing Poké Balls!

When the ring’s color is green, it means that
Pokémon is easy to catch, right?\c
And when it’s yellow, it’s a bit harder. But when
it’s red, it becomes super hard!

I fed a Nanab Berry to a wild Pokémon, and it
seemed to calm the Pokémon down!\c
It stopped jumping around, so I was able to
aim with my Poké Balls easily!

You know, you have a better chance of catching
a Pokémon with a Great Ball than with
a Poké Ball.\c
Even then, it’s not a guaranteed catch, of course.
